name: panorama
label: Spectrum analyzer
description: Stepped sweep across a range wider than one span — the spectrum analyzer tool's engine.
ai_notes: Spectrum analyzer (stepped sweep). The `src` block hops the LO across [sweep_start_hz, sweep_stop_hz] (~7.6 MHz per step at 10 MS/s, ~90 ms/step) and emits one row per step to the `panorama` store kind (keyed by step: the current records are the last full pass; `power` = base64 little-endian i16 centi-dBFS from `f_lo_hz` in `bin_hz` steps). Change the range / resolution live with set_block_param(block='src', params={sweep_start_hz, sweep_stop_hz, rbw_hz, averages}). Gain/antenna are the operator's radio settings; AGC is forced off. There is no audio or receiver chain in this preset — load a receiver preset to listen.
